synopsis: On the way to their new home, 10-year-old Chihiro Ogino's family stumbles upon a deserted theme park. synopsis: Onizuka is a reformed biker gang leader who has his sights set on an honorable new ambition: to become the world's greatest teacher... for the purpose of meeting sexy high school girls.
